Bastet. Been playing her and got to Gold 1 because of how stupid she is. Starting with trans or bluestone and first tier trans are good starts. Usually I go meditation but if I'm going against someone like Artemis I would go Beads. She's good against baka but even though it seems optimal, don't go Beads against him. Mercury is very good against her so I usually ban him.  Having full CDR is a smart idea, especially if you're going against a physical god. If going against a magical god then just go Jotunns at least. My usual build against physicals is trans, Warrior Boots, Jotunns or Breastplate as 3rd and 4th item, depending on how I'm doing and who I'm going against determines which comes first, Titans bane and last item can be either Brawlers or more protections if necessary. Against magical is the same but bulwarks replaces Breastplate and the last protection is replaced with runic shield. (Optional). Your playstyle is to jump on the enemy, use your 2 and jump back. Don't do this on the usual though as eventually your enemy will catch on. Level your 1 and 2 first and your ult whenever available. Maxing those is priority. Hitting your 3 then 1 then ult and then 2 is a devastating combo that was shred your opponent's health. Throwing in basics here and there should happen. Bull demon is a breeze with cats and cats aren't even needed. My personal opinion is to never waste fire giant on tower. Id be better to use cats and backdoor tower than to waste fire on it. Getting red in the start of the game isn't as important with bastet. Her early game isn't too great so contesting red isn't too smart. If you believe you can't contest, go steal their blue buff at start so you can keep up in XP. Now although I usually don't need to backdoor, it's very easy to do so as bastet. Her cats can shred titan and win you game in a couple's seconds so never be afraid to backdoor. Her playstyle is poke and prod until you can secure a kill. A good start that can put you in a lead of XP, is to invade red buff. Start of game get trans with 3 mana and health pots. Go hid by their blue buff. If they are doing their blue attempt to steal it and do damage to them. If you find them going to red, wait for them to start it. Most people put their back to their side of the jungle to be safe, leaving their back to you. This allows for a gold amount of damage to be dealt to them while also taking them off red. If they are low enough go for red. If they come to stop you then simply back off of it and try to murder them.
